name: Slag Pit
summary: In the Cauldron, the Slag Pit drives the Dark Iron dwarves’ mining. Slavers force workers through the tunnels while incendosaurs prowl below.

sections.title: Subterranean Toil
sections.body: The Slag Pit cuts into the Cauldron, where Dark Iron dwarves force enslaved workers to mine ore and minerals. Overseers and taskmasters keep them digging day and night. Beneath Blackrock Mountain, the tunnels feed supply lines to Blackrock Depths. The Dark Irons guard those lines against anyone who interferes.

sections.title: Depths of the Pit
sections.body: Below, the tunnels open into scorching caverns where incendosaurs roam. These fierce reptiles threaten workers and intruders alike. Still, the Dark Iron masters drive their laborers deeper into the rock, heedless of the lives lost.

faq.q: Where is the Slag Pit located?
aliases: how to get to slag pit
faq.answer: The Slag Pit lies deep inside the Cauldron, the great excavation crater at the center of Searing Gorge. Its tunnels run beneath the surface mining works.
Dark Iron slavers and taskmasters control the Slag Pit. They patrol its shafts and drive their captives to dig around the clock.

faq.q: Why do the slave workers attack intruders?
faq.answer: Enslaved workers attack intruders to avoid punishment from their Dark Iron masters. When a nearby slaver or taskmaster is attacked, fear sends the laborers rushing to defend the overseer.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Slag Pit?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves, enslaved workers, and incendosaurs live in the Slag Pit. The incendosaurs prowl its deepest tunnels.

angles.text: The Slag Pit’s deep shafts cut into Searing Gorge’s mineral-rich rock, where rich ore waits at great danger.
As a dwarf of Ironforge, you see the bitter divide between the clans in the cruelty of the Dark Iron slavers.
